title: walk.py: what the walk does when a chain ends (usage limits first)
about: Task W132 (stop at a usage limit) on top of the walk. A walk starts work chains, one task each, on a session budget. Each tick it judges the chains that ended: walk_decide turns a chain's stop cause into run, hold, stop, raise or pend. A usage limit is the one cause the walk waits out and retries; stop_on_limit ends the walk there instead.
